reference.notes: 2024 Italian GP Q3 pole (1:19.327). monza.speeds.json does not exist yet; this is the intended shared reference lap for a future speed profile. Line is the dry qualifying push line, not Norris's slightly early T2 (he said that cost ~0.15 s).

corners.name: Variante del Rettifilo
corners.notes: Right-then-left. Enter from the right of the pit straight; T1 rides the right (inside) kerb; T2 is a late left-kerb apex; exit settles right for Biassono. Checklist 'left then right' kerbs is inverted vs T1-right / T2-left — sources win.

corners.name: Curva Biassono
corners.notes: Almost flat right-hand sweeper. Mid-to-outside (negative = left of a right-hander). No tight inside apex. Drifts back right afterward to set up Roggia.

corners.name: Variante della Roggia
corners.notes: Left-then-right. Aggressive left kerb then right kerb. T5 exit runs out left (Track Titan / classic setup for Lesmo 1). Checklist 'exit right for Lesmo 1' is read as the T5 right apex, not a right-side exit.

corners.name: Lesmo 1
corners.notes: Late apex vs centerline peak at 2210. Miss the inside kerb (Track Titan). Run out left toward Lesmo 2. 'Right exit' in the prompt is the late-apex inside; the car still opens left.

corners.name: Lesmo 2
corners.notes: Tighter and later than Lesmo 1. Painted/recessed inside kerb. Full left-side exit onto the back section.

corners.name: Curva del Serraglio
corners.notes: Slight left kink (~12° over ~125 m). Small offset change; hold the Lesmo-2 exit line and start drifting right for Ascari.

corners.name: Variante Ascari
corners.notes: L-R-L. Turn in from the right (entry kerb). 2024 trackside: stay wider on T8, attack T9 kerb, late modest T10, exit wide right onto the opposite straight.

corners.name: Curva Alboreto
corners.notes: Wide left entry. Centerline is tightest at s=4864 (entry) — the racing apex is much later, inside-right, missing the kerb. Unwind to the left white line for the pit straight.
